$comment: Budget policy v2 (docs/implementation/performance_budgets.md). Each route is the gzip size of the files a user downloads for it: the shell always, every other route only what it adds on top of the shell. Raising a budget needs a PR that edits this file and appends a row to the budget log in performance_budgets.md.

shell.description: First paint: index.html plus every CSS and JavaScript file it loads before the app is usable.

editor.description: Loaded with the first open note: outline, backlink and unlinked-mention index, back/forward navigation.

recovery.description: Revision history, backup center, recovery service, and backup verification.

retrieval.description: Command palette and its command list, find and replace, saved views, archive, bulk actions, link tools.

daily.description: Daily notes, quick capture, task dashboard, calendar.

properties.description: Properties view and the YAML frontmatter parser.

workspace.description: Tabs and split panes, web clipper, Markdown-folder reconciliation.

dialogs.description: In-app confirm dialog and toasts (src/ui/dialogs.js), loaded on first use.

banner.description: Note banner picker, gradient presets and Reposition (src/components/banner-picker.js), loaded when the pointer or focus first reaches a banner.

conflicts.description: Conflict comparison, draft recovery and resolution; explicit replacement also loads the recovery route for safety history.

storageRecovery.description: Read-only recovery reader before vault activation; verified backup export also loads the backup core from the recovery route.

vaultRefresh.description: Cross-window refresh hints and consistent clean-window adoption, loaded after the initial usable app.

precache.description: Everything the service worker precaches for offline use (all of dist/ except sw.js itself).
